{{Quote|We're going to have to be very careful out here.|Aeron Azzameen|<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>}}
A series of '''cargo fields''' belonged to the [[Azzameen family]], owners of [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] company [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]], around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The cargo fields contained a number of [[Xizor cargo container|cargo containers]] full of varied cargo in at least three plots and were considered a secret known only to the family. After [[Aeron Azzameen]] accidentally deleted records on the contents of containers stored in the fields, she and her [[Gender/Legends|brother]] [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]] manually inspected the fields to rebuild the database. During their mission, the siblings came upon a number of intruding [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including the [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ship]] ''[[Enkidu]]'' sabotaging one of the plots on behalf of the Azzameens' rivals, [[Viraxo Industries]]. Finding that the security of the plots had been compromised due to these breaches, the Azzameens determined that the cargo containers held in the area would have to be moved.

==Description==
{{Quote|We will fly together to the three affected cargo storage areas. We must inspect all cargo containers in each area then return home.|MK-09 briefs Ace Azzameen on the mission to restore the family's database|<ref name="XWA" />}}
Several cargo fields were maintained by the [[Azzameen family]], [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] who owned and operated the shipping company [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]],<ref name="XWA" /> around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="3ABY">The events of ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' begin shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]; later, an ''X-Wing Alliance'' mission depicts the [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards]], which ''The New Essential Chronology'' places in 3.5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]. The mission featuring the cargo fields takes place between these two battles.</ref> The fields consisted of at least three distinct plots; each plot contained a number of [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]] [[Xizor cargo container|cargo containers]],<ref name="XWA" /> arranged in such a way to be easily and quickly inspected.<ref name="XWAPrima">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> One of the plots comprised [[Class-G cargo container|Class-G]] and [[Class-I cargo container|Class-I]] [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] holding shelters and [[Fertilizer/Legends|fertilizer]], respectively. The second plot accommodated [[pressure tank]]s containing [[LOX]] and [[Class-J cargo container]]s holding construction equipment. The last of the three plots consisted of [[Class-K cargo container|Class-K]] and [[Class-L cargo container]]s; the Class-K containers held [[teel wood]], and the Class-L containers held [[hydron]]. The plots were separated from each other and the Azzameen's home, an [[Orbital platform/Legends|orbital platform]] known as [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]], by a distance requiring a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|jump]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The fields' location was an Azzameen family secret in order to protect the cargo stored there from [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] or [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]],<ref name="XWA" /> though the family did report the location to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] inspectors.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

==History==
{{Quote|Unidentified ship, you are trespassing. State your business.''"<br />"''Looks like they are bugging out, Aeron. Should we stop them?''"<br />"''Yeah, if we can. We need to know what's going on here.|Aeron and Emkay discuss the intruding ''Enkidu''|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:Sabra-Encounters-Raiders.png|thumb|right|200px|Ace Azzameen, piloting the ''Sabra'', intercepts the ''Raider''.]]
While applying an upgrade to the security system of the cargo fields in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="3ABY" /> family [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Aeron Azzameen]] accidentally deleted database entries for the contents of the containers located in three of the cargo fields' plots. She enlisted the help of her [[Gender/Legends|brother]] [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]], who had only recently begun to fly [[Starship/Legends|ships]] for his [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|father's]] company, to inspect each container in order to manually recreate the lost information. After departing Azzameen Station in the family's two [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]]&mdash;Aeron in the ''[[Selu]]'' and Ace flying the ''[[Sabra]]''&mdash;the siblings successfully scanned the contents of the first plot without incident.<ref name="XWA" />

Moving on to the next plot, the Azzameens discovered the [[cargo ferry]] [[Raider (cargo ferry)|''Raider'']] attempting to steal a container;<ref name="XWA" /> Ace swiftly dispatched the intruding ship.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Upon reaching the third plot, the Azzameens discovered more interlopers in the [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ship]] ''[[Enkidu]]'' and its [[Razor-class starfighter|''Razor''-class]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] escort. The ''Enkidu'', acting on orders from the Azzameens' rivals, [[Viraxo Industries]], was clandestinely adding contraband [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to one of the containers in an effort to sabotage the Azzameens and Twin Suns Transport Services. After [[Starfighter combat/Legends|defeating]] the escorts and chasing off the ''Enkidu'', Aeron concluded that the location of the fields, formerly unknown to anyone but the Azzameens, had been compromised; the family [[MK-series maintenance droid|droid]], [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]], lamented that the cargo containers would have to be moved as a result. The ''Selu'' collected the sabotaged container and continued inspecting the last field. When complete, both Azzameen ships returned to Azzameen Station, contraband in tow.<ref name="XWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Azzameen cargo fields appeared in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|PC game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''.<ref name="XWA" />
